sources.notes: 309 pages, chart amendments EFF 31 OCT 2024 ... 2 OCT 2025. SID/STAR route descriptions, RNAV coding tables (altitude/speed per waypoint), waypoint coordinate tables, IAC charts, AD2.19 navaids, AD2.12 thresholds, AD2.20/22 runway-use rules. Primary source for procedures.

sources.notes: All/Sectors/RJTG.sct ([VOR],[FIXES],[LOW/HIGH AIRWAY], magvar 8.0) and RJTG.ese ([SIDSSTARS] tagged "2504 by VATJPN ES Team"). Used for coordinates of fixes/navaids and airway topology. 206 fix coordinates were cross-checked against AIP waypoint tables and matched within 0.02NM.

magVar.note: RJTT RNAV coding tables use magnetic variation -7.9 (7.9 deg W); RJAA tables use -7.5 (7.5 W); all IAC/SID charts print "VAR 8 deg W". VATJPN sector file uses 8.0. Negative = West (true = magnetic - 7.9).

HOW THE KANTO AIRSPACE WORKS (from AIP Japan RJTT/RJAA AD2.20-2.24):
- Haneda (RJTT) has 4 runways: 16L/34R, 16R/34L (parallel, 3000-3360m), 04/22 and 05/23 (crossing, 2500m). Runway configuration is chosen by wind:
  * North-wind ops (2100-1400UTC): land 34L + 34R, depart 34R (and 05). Arrivals use the "A/K/C/H" RNAV STARs (OSHIMA/AKSEL/AROSA from the south-west & south, GODIN/POLIX from the north-east). A = to ARLON (ILS Z 34L), K = to KAIHO (ILS X/Y 34L & Y 34R short approach), C = to CREAM, H = to CACAO (ILS Z 34R). In daytime 34R normally gets HIGHWAY VISUAL 34R, 34L gets ILS X 34L.
  * South-wind ops (2100-1400UTC outside the afternoon window): land 22 + 23, depart 16L/16R (and 22 for some). STARs "N/B" (to NYLON/BACON, from OSHIMA/AKSEL/AROSA) and "S/D" (to STEAM/DATUM, from GODIN/POLIX). Daytime approaches are the noise-abatement LDA W 22 / LDA W 23 (not encoded here), ILS 22 / ILS Z 23 as fallback.
  * South-wind afternoon window, about 3h within 0600-1000UTC (15-19 JST) = the 2020 "new routes" over central Tokyo: land 16L + 16R (simultaneous), depart 16L/16R/22. STARs "L" (to SANDY) and "R" (to NATTY). Primary approaches are RNP RWY16L / RNP RWY16R with a STEEP 3.45 deg vertical path (CONFIRMED in AIP; PAPI 3.25 deg). The ILS 16L/16R glide paths are 3.0 deg (also confirmed, AD2.19) and are used only when the RNP approach is not applicable. Departures in this window use the "C" variant SIDs (TIARA/BEKLA/ROVER C).
  * Night 1400-2100UTC: land 34R (north) or 23 (south) preferentially; NIGHT STARs to KAIHO, V STARs to DARKS (VOR A circling 16L). Departures 05 (OPPAR/VISIP conventional) etc.
- SID naming: TIARA/BEKLA/ROVER have time-based variants A (2100-1400UTC), B (2200-0230UTC: 34R right turn ARAKA-GUGVA-OHEDO), C (~0600-1000UTC). SID exit points: west/Kansai-Nagoya = GUSRO, TIARA, BEKLA (Y18/Y20 via KAMAT/LAYER/INTEL), NINOX (Y28), LAXAS (Y56), VAMOS/RUTAS/DRAKY->XAC (south-west/Izu), OPPAR/VISIP (night); north = ROVER (AKAGI, AGRIS via BRUCE); east/Pacific = ROVER INUBO transition (Y16/Y50/Y51/Y60/Y804/Y806/Y808/Y820/Y830 all start at INUBO).
- Arrivals into Haneda from the west (Kansai/Nagoya/Kyushu) enter via OSHIMA (XAC VORTAC, Izu-Oshima) and AKSEL; from the south/Pacific via AROSA (and MESSE at night); from Tohoku/Hokkaido via GODIN (end of Y10) and POLIX (end of Y807, Pacific/North America flows from the north-east).
- Narita (RJAA): 16R/34L (4000m) and 16L/34R (2500m), parallel independent. North-wind: STARs "E" (to ELGAR) and "T" (to TYLER) -> ILS 34L (intercept 4000) / ILS Z 34R (intercept 5000). South-wind: STARs "G" (to GEMIN) and "N" (to NORMA) -> ILS Z 16R (4000) / ILS Z 16L (3000). STAR entry points: RUTAS (south-west/Izu, shared with Haneda RUTAS SID exit), SWAMP (north: Tohoku/Hokkaido/North America via R211/Y30), SUPOK (south: Y809, Asia/Guam), LUBLA (south-east: Y813). SIDs: TETRA (west, transitions AGRIS/KIMIN north, ENPAR west), REDEK/PIGOK (east, Pacific), GULBO/BORLO (south-east, Pacific), PEDLA (south), OLVAN (+SAMUS), conventional SAKURA/AKAGI/SUNNS (SUNNS = start of oceanic OTR16/OTR20 towards the North Pacific).
- Typical STAR altitude gates: Haneda north-wind ANZAC/WANDA 13000 (230kt), AKSEL/WALLY 12000, AVEEY/WALTZ 11000, WEDGE 8000, ARLON/KAIHO 4000-5000 holds; Narita VENUS/YUMIL 11000 (220kt), PEAKS 6000, CASIO 6000.
- Holding: published holds at XAC, ANZAC, WEDGE, ARLON (MHA 4000-5000), UTIBO (MHA 5000), CHIBA (MHA 3000), KASGA (MHA 4000), SNOKE (4000), BINKS (5000), BOSPA (missed approach 8000). Speed MAX 230KIAS at/below FL140, 240 above.

DATA CONVENTIONS:
- Altitudes in feet; FL converted to feet (FL150 = 15000). altMin==altMax means "AT"; only altMin = "at or above"; only altMax = "at or below". ACELA/LUNAR windows encoded as min/max.
- speed = KIAS value from the AIP RNAV coding table at that waypoint (published as a speed restriction; values like "-250"/"-220" in AIP are max speeds, stored as plain numbers).
- STAR/SID legs come from the AIP RNAV coding tables (parsed automatically and spot-checked against the textual route descriptions). The initial VA/heading legs of SIDs are described in "note" (not as fixes).
- Approaches: legs list only the named points from IAF to FAF (role IAF/IF/FAF). locCourseMag for RNP approaches is the RNAV final track.
- verified=true for coordinates means: from AIP chart/table directly, or from the VATJPN sector file (AIP-derived). Fix notes say when coordinates were also matched against an AIP waypoint table.

KNOWN GAPS / CAVEATS:
- VISIP (new conventional SID fix, TTE R178/D28.1) and SAPTI (new IAF ILS Z 34R, D20.3 ITC) have no published lat/lon in public sources: coordinates computed, verified=false.
- Conventional STARs SULPU 1S/1D and OLRAT 1A/1B (RJTT, new EFF 2025; DME-arc based) are NOT included: SULPU/OLRAT coordinates not found. Old conventional STARs in the sector file (SINGO/DOYLE/BONUS) are obsolete (SINGO abolished).
- SEKIYADO departure (conventional, chart text font-garbled), ISOGO 3 (props only) and all LDA approaches (LDA W/X/Y/Z 22/23 incl. the daytime noise-abatement LDA W), LOC/VOR/GLS approaches and RNP RWY23(AR) were not encoded; HIGHWAY VISUAL 34R not encoded. RJAA ILS Y/X variants, VOR, RNP approaches not encoded.
- HANEDA VOR/DME HME 112.2 was replaced by TOKYO VOR/DME TTE 117.4 (new site 35-33-36N 139-45-54E). Many older community files still use HME; this file uses TTE. HME kept as verified=false reference.
- No "Ami" VOR found in current data (not in sector file VOR list); not included. Miyake-jima navaid appears as MOE ("OYAMA") 108.65.
- Airways: topology from the VATJPN sector file (segment list), order reconstructed; may lag the current AIRAC and does not encode direction/levels. Oceanic NOPAC/PACOTS tracks beyond the Fukuoka FIR boundary are not included (only OTR16/OTR20 stubs SMOLT-ESKOK-SUNNS / SUNNS-RENAU-ADKAK present in the sector file).
- ENR 3 (airways) of AIP Japan was not available in the public mirror; airway lists therefore are community data, not AIP.
- TACAN/VORTAC typing of some military navaids follows the sector file; coordinates/frequencies are from the sector file, not individually verified against AIP ENR 4.1.
